name: pramana
description: PRAMANA — MPLADS Statistical Integrity & Transparency Explorer. A statistical transparency and analytical prototype; not the official e-SAKSHI portal.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend start
